name: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited

facts.business: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited operates a multi-state network of hospitals providing multispecialty and super-specialty healthcare services with a focus on clinical excellence, accessible healthcare, and integrated care delivery.
key_risks: Impairment risk on investments and loans to subsidiaries due to judgmental assumptions in discounted cash flow models
Economic uncertainties affecting discount rates, projected growth rates, and terminal values in impairment testing
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not entered into any non-cash transactions with its directors or persons connected with its directors. Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements.
